result: No blocking layout issue was observed in the six captured Phase0A states.

observations: Neutral light UI and bamboo assistant mark are visible.
Tool summary precedes final text; changed-file summary and delivery cards follow the text with a shared left edge.
Active project chat appears once; pinned, independent and orphan entries remain visible.
Three bordered completed tool rows are visible: two writes and one delivery.
Expanded tool rows keep the final text above the change and delivery cards.
The note counter reads 9000 / 8192 bytes in red.
Save is visually disabled while Clear remains visibly enabled; the test result separately verifies the actual clear action.
The persistent error toast sits at the top above the long editor.
The editor shows an internal scroll region and a visible fixed control row; model and send controls are not covered by the toast.
The editor contracts after replacing long text with short text.
The same error toast remains above the editor, with model and send controls visible.
At the recorded 950 by 912 viewport, neutral dark colors and the bamboo mark on a pale backing are visible.
Text, change card, delivery cards and actions remain aligned; the input control row is visible.

limitations: These are AI observations of six screenshots, not human approval.
No claim of Harness/ChatGPT/Codex pixel parity is made.
These screenshots do not cover all pages, interaction states, DPI settings, Windows display setups or accessibility modes.
Screenshots alone cannot establish persistence, actual button effects, model quality, installation or upgrade behavior; the separate recorded assertions establish only their specific tested behavior.
Toast placement is checked for unobstructed editor controls; the screenshots show the toast over part of the header region.
